conventions.lambda_missing: version 4, decision 54: a fired row without lambda runs at lambda 1.00, flagged, and every statistic is also reported without such rows. It is in no lambda band: the lambda~1 and enriched bands are defined on the row's own lambda, and the split classifies such a row into neither (thresholds/split.py, classify); so it enters, at lambda 1.00, the statistics of the fired and hot populations (E1, E2, D1) and none taken over a lambda band (E3, E4, E5, L0, L1). In E8, which compares the model ECU with EPA's own lambda and spark, it enters ds only, and dl is taken over the Final rows that publish lambda; the counts behind dl and ds are reported. That is version 4's reading of decision 54, written after its fourth review: read literally, 'every statistic' would compare such a row's EPA lambda as 1.00, a value EPA did not publish, so the dl that gates is the one without such rows, and dl with them at 1.00 is reported beside it, so that dl is reported both ways as decision 54 asks. dl needs at least 3 rows that publish a lambda, or E8 has no statistic (statistic_details.e8_subsets). A Ford HD1 row with either bank's lambda empty is a row without lambda (version 4's reading of decision 54, written after its sixth review): the HD1 lambda is the mean of its two banks (thresholds/split.py, lam), which then has none, and the split already classifies such a row into no lambda band; one bank alone is not the lambda every other HD1 row is given
conventions.spark_sentinel: version 4, decision 54: a row whose published spark is EPA's sentinel, exactly -120 (the Mazda's fuel-cut points read so, epa_map.py:47-48), enters no fit; in every statistic, in-sample and held-out alike, it runs at the model ECU's spark (30 s dwell, no knock retard, EPA's intake temperature), flagged, and every statistic is also reported without it: a declared outcome, never a stop. Version 4's readings of decision 54, written after its fourth review, each with its reason: (1) in E8 it has no published spark to compare: it enters dl only, and the ds that gates is taken over the Final rows that publish a spark, since run at the model ECU's spark it would add a difference of zero to ds by construction, which is no measurement and would pull ds toward a pass; ds with those rows, at a difference of zero, as decision 54 reads literally, is reported beside it, so that ds is reported both ways; (2) in D1 it runs at the model ECU's spark at EPA's MAP, the spark it runs at in every other statistic, plus s*(MAP - MAP_EPA), as a published spark is moved to the inverted MAP, so that D1 treats every row alike; the other reading, the model ECU's spark at the inverted MAP, differs from it by the schedule's curvature over MAP - MAP_EPA. ds needs at least 3 rows that publish a spark, or E8 has no statistic (statistic_details.e8_subsets). A row whose Spark Timing cell is empty is a sentinel row: it enters no fit, and in every statistic, E8 and D1 included, it runs as above (version 4's reading of decision 54, written after its sixth review, its fit named after its seventh): it publishes no spark either, and version 3, which fed every row its spark as published, had no rule for it. Whether any fired row has an empty spark, or any HD1 row an empty bank (lambda_missing), was not looked up when these readings were written: the session that wrote them opened no EPA table, epa_channels.csv included, and each rule holds either way
conventions.held_out_counts: version 4, decision 54: the held-out rows' counts of lambda-less and sentinel rows are taken only when the held-out run is armed, before any statistic; with them, whether each of E8's subsets holds enough rows (statistic_details.e8_subsets) is decided before E8 is computed
conventions.censored: version 4, decision 54: an engine's lambda is censored when at least 2 of its calibration High Load Final rows sit at their own minimum lambda within 1e-9, or at a documented sensor floor: defined on the calibration Final rows themselves, never on all rows; censored rows are kept, treated one-sided in the enrichment fit, and flagged in E4a and E4b. A sensor floor is documented only by a source opened and cited before the fit that states the lower end of the range of the lambda sensor EPA used on that engine (EPA's report of that test, or the datasheet of a sensor it names); with no such source, only the two-row test applies. E8 lists them too, and gates nothing on the list (version 4, written after its sixth review): its dl compares EPA's lambda on the held-out Final rows, and a reading held at the sensor's floor sits above the lambda the engine ran, which biases dl. A held-out Final row is censored when its engine's lambda is censored and the row's lambda sits at the censoring value, the calibration rows' minimum within 1e-9 or the documented floor; one whose lambda reads below the censoring value is not counted censored, since it shows that the sensor reads lower (after the seventh review); E8 lists the censored rows and reports dl without them beside the dl that gates, and the list moves no label, R, population or statistic

On a form-D engine the intake cam is the model ECU's schedule cam(rpm, MAP) at the inverted MAP, evaluated there, not moved linearly as the spark is (docs/build_step_2/PLAN.md section 6.3, D1's row; decision 41: the cam is run by the ECU); in every statistic at EPA's MAP it is the schedule at the row's MAP. A sentinel row's spark in D1 is spark_sentinel's (version 4's reading of decision 54)
statistic_details.e8: EPA's lambda in dl is lambda_meas - (lambda_ref - 1), unsnapped: the snap (lambda) is a rule for the lambda fed to the model, and E8 compares EPA's lambda, which it feeds to nothing; the snapped E8 is reported beside it, descriptive, so E6 row 12 does not list E8. The rows dl and ds are taken over are version 4's reading of decision 54 (lambda_missing, spark_sentinel), not decision 57's. P is piecewise linear through the measured shifts; a shift beyond them is extrapolated linearly from the last segment (thresholds.contract.interp), and flagged. u_val propagates u(dl) and u(ds) through the slope of the segment that holds the shift, at a shift of exactly 0 the steeper of the two segments beside it. The tightening keeps, at each shift, the larger |response|, with its sign
statistic_details.e8_subsets: version 4's reading of decision 54, written after its fifth review: dl and ds are each a pooled mean over its own subset of the held-out High Load Final rows, dl over those that publish a lambda and ds over those that publish a spark, and each needs at least 3 rows (3 clusters, a Final row being one), the least on which this contract computes a line's statistic (thresholds/split.py MIN_CLUSTERS; the line rule of rows). If either subset has fewer, E8 has no statistic: it is a d row with no statistic, and the engine is dropped (on_failure.d; decision 36). The term of a subset that is large enough, and dl and ds over every Final row as decision 54 reads literally (lambda 1.00, a spark difference of zero), are then reported, descriptive. Why: E8 is the sum of the baseline's two levers, and the term a short subset leaves out would read that lever as exact, the guessed baseline of mistake 3; taking it over every Final row instead would compare a lambda of 1.00, or a spark difference of zero, that EPA did not publish. Version 3's one population, the held-out Final rows (engines.<id>.pooled_counts.E8_final_rows), is at least that large on every engine; the counts that decide the subsets are taken when the held-out run is armed (held_out_counts), so the outcome is fixed before E8 is computed

neutral_action_identity.action: engine_env.neutral_action(): its spark, lambda and boost trims rescale to exactly 0.0 in float32 (SupervisoryTunerEnv._rescale), its fan and pump to 1.0 (version_4.plant_values; step 7 checks both)
neutral_action_identity.identity: at every step of the episode, the agent's lambda equals float32(lambda_b) and its spark float32(spark_b), lambda_b and spark_b the baseline ECU's outputs of that step (BaselineECU.step, called at engine_env.py:1283); reported: the largest |difference| on each channel over the episode, which must be 0, and the clip contacts, which must be 0
neutral_action_identity.contact: a step at which one of the two channel clips changed the value it was given, np.clip(x, lo, hi) != x, x the float32 sum SupervisoryTunerEnv.step forms: lambda_b + trim against ecu.lam_floor and ecu.lam_ceiling (engine_env.py:1316), spark_b + trim against ecu.spark_min and ecu.spark_max (engine_env.py:1310-1311). The comparison is the environment's own, in float32: a Python float bound is cast to float32 against a float32 sum (NEP 50), and a NumPy float64 one would make the comparison, and the result, float64. The lambda bounds are Python floats by engines.Engine's own check (engines.py:598-602); the spark bounds have no such check: the B58's are typed in its spec as floats (engine_specs/b58.toml:119-120), and an EPA engine's are DERIVED, which engines._number converts to a Python float (engines.py:1032-1035). The identity check therefore asserts, before it runs, that all four bounds are Python floats (type(x) is float). A script that compares with float64 bounds counts float32(lam_floor) < lam_floor as a contact, and is wrong. So could the environment, if a spark bound were a NumPy float64: at a step where BaselineECU.step returns exactly spark_min, the clip would compare float32(spark_min), which can sit below spark_min, in float64. A value equal to a bound is not a contact: the build-step-2 invariant 1 - enr_depth >= lam_floor (engines.Engine, engines.py:603) lets the baseline's deepest lambda sit exactly on float32(lam_floor), and equality would count a contact only if that invariant were strict. Only the two channel clips count: the action box (SupervisoryTunerEnv._rescale, engine_env.py:1031), the slew and action-range clips and the spark-trim cap (engine_env.py:1249-1251) are not contacts, since the slew moves the fan and pump by design after reset and a change any of them made to a trim shows as a difference of the identity. The certificate harness's HARNESS_BIND_COUNT, which counts equality with float32(bound), is not this count (docs/build_step_2/HANDOFFS.md, WP2 item 2)

steps.gated: every step of a scored climb outside its transitions: a step is a transition step when the road's grade there differs from its grade at the step before, or the road's speed there differs from its speed at the step before or at the step after, since the demand at a step is computed from the road's speed, its change to the next step and its grade (engine_env.py:1254-1257, SupervisoryTunerEnv.step); every grade change is a ramp (training gate item 4, CLAUDE.md), GRADE_RAMP_S long on the locked climb (engine_env.py:1644). 'Differs' is exact inequality (!=) of the float64 values of the road's grade and speed arrays as the roads step records them, the arrays the environment reads (c['grade'], c['v_mps']), with no tolerance (version 4, decision 73, written after its fourth review)
steps.dt: a road's steps are its steps at the time step its scored climbs are scored at, which the roads step records with the roads: the arrays the environment reads at that time step. The transition test and every count of steps depend on it (engine_env.make_terrain and make_grade_climb take it), and C5 never re-samples a road at another (version 4, decision 73, written after its fifth review)
steps.gated_step: a step is gated on a car when at least one margin gates there: a step outside the climb's transitions at which the held gear's own margin gates or a rejected higher gear's does. A step outside the transitions at which none does is not gated, and there are exactly three such steps: the CVT's low-speed branch, which has no margin; a stepped box's lowest gear when it is also the highest the road speed allows, so that no higher gear is rejected (threshold.no_decision); and a stepped box's held gear whose next lower gear is barred by SHIFT_RPM_MAX (threshold.rpm_bar) when it is also the highest the road speed allows, for the same reason. At every other step at least one margin gates: on the CVT's economy, kickdown and power-limited branches T_eco's at N_eco, and on a stepped box the held gear's or a rejected higher gear's. A step that is not gated is reported with the car's gear or branch, and counts neither toward the gated-step minimum (no_gated_step) nor toward the gated share (thin). These cases decide first, at any demand: a step whose demand is at or below 0 is gated only where one of its margins gates, and that margin is then at least 1, which passes (version 4, decision 73, written after its fifth review; the third case and the order of the rules after its sixth)
steps.share: the share of each scored climb's steps that are transition steps, and on each car the share that are gated, are reported with the climb, on every road kind: on a road whose speed changes at every step of an acceleration or a coast, as the extremes kind's does (engine_env.extreme_speed_profile), most of a climb can be transition steps, and C5 then gates a small part of it (version 4, decision 73, written after its fourth review; the gated share after its fifth)
steps.outcome: C5's outcome for a scored climb on a car, at the margin it is checked at there (R_E1a at the draw and at a redraw, the re-check margin after the held-out run: redraw.recheck), is exactly one of three cases (version 4, decision 73, written after its seventh review): (1) it fails when some gated margin, |demand / threshold - 1| at a gated step, is at or below the margin; (2) it is thinly checked when no gated margin is at or below the margin and its gated steps on the car are fewer than thin_below_share of its steps; (3) it passes when neither holds. The cases are exclusive, and every climb is in one on every car (step 7 checks the case table). At the draw and at a redraw a candidate in case (1) on any car fails a test of the first draw and is discarded, as is one with no gated step on some car, which is in case (2) there (no_gated_step); one in case (2) on a car with a gated step there is accepted and flagged thin there (thin). At the re-check after the held-out run a scored climb in case (1) on any car is redrawn for every car (redraw.redraw), and one in case (2) is not redrawn
steps.thin: a scored climb whose gated steps on a car are fewer than half its steps (thin_below_share) is flagged thin on that car, whichever case of outcome it is in, and is never reported as passed there; the flag is known at the draw, from the road, the car and its frozen plant, and is reported with the roads, with the climb's gated share. A thin climb that fails at a gated step fails C5 there (outcome case (1)): it is discarded at the draw and redrawn at its re-check, and a slot that keeps it at the cap is flagged gear-sensitive and thin on that car (redraw.at_cap). A thin climb with no failing gated step is thinly checked there (case (2)): it is reported so, scored and not redrawn, and it neither passes nor fails C5, so it does not make its car gear-sensitive (redraw.no_passing_car). The first draw and a redraw both accept a candidate in case (2) on a car, if it has a gated step there (no_gated_step), and flag it thin; each car's results are reported with and without its thin climbs (version 4, decision 73, written after its fifth review, which found that on a road whose speed changes at every step C5 could gate almost none of a climb and pass it on one step; the cases after its seventh). The share, one half (thin_below_share), is DESIGN, chosen from no data (labelled after the sixth review): no road has been drawn, so no climb's gated share has been seen; it is the least share at which a climb that C5 reports as passed was gated on at least as many of its steps as it left ungated. It moves what is reported as passed and nothing else: a thin climb is still scored and fails C5 as any climb does, and every car's results are reported with and without such climbs
steps.range: a scored climb's steps run from the first step of its ramp up to the last step of its ramp down, and the roads step records each climb slot's first and last step with the roads, before any held-out statistic; the road before and after a scored climb is not C5's. The neighbours the transition test compares are the road's steps, inside the climb or not, so a climb's first and last steps are transition steps, its grade ramping there, unless the climb starts at the road's first step or ends at its last. The road's first step has no step before it and its last no step after: a missing neighbour is taken as the step itself, as the environment takes the step after the last (engine_env.py:1255), where the speed's change to the next step is zero (version 4, decision 73, written after its third review)
steps.ramps: the transition steps' margins and their gear sequence (the CVT's branch) are reported beside the result, not gated: in a transition the box changes gear by design, and the margin at the steps around the change depends on where the steps fall and can be arbitrarily small; the gear the climb is driven in is checked at every step outside its transitions
steps.steady_acceleration: the reason not to gate a transition holds only near the steps at which the gear, or the CVT's branch, actually changes: between them a steady acceleration or coast holds its gear, and a torque error the validation accepts could still hand it back or take the next one there, which C5 does not check; the thin flag reports the climbs on which that matters. The other readings would gate those steps: a transition only where the grade or the acceleration changes, with a fixed neighbourhood (version 4's fourth review), or only within a fixed neighbourhood of a step at which a car's gear or the CVT's branch changes, and of the grade ramps (its fifth). Neither is taken in version 4, because neither has a width that follows from the reason for not gating a transition: the steps around a gear change made by design whose margin a torque error within the margin can cross are those over which the demand moves by about the margin against the threshold, so how many they are is set by how fast the demand crosses the threshold there, few on a ramp and many on a slow acceleration; the speed test's width of one step comes from the demand's own definition, which reads the speed's change to the next step, and not from that. A one-step neighbourhood would therefore gate, on a slow acceleration, steps at which a torque error within the margin only moves the timing of a gear change the box makes by design, and fail every such climb, which is what not gating a transition prevents; a width derived from the margin and the demand's rate would be a new rule no review has examined. Version 4's fifth correction also gave as a reason that the second reading makes the transition steps each car's; its sixth review found that no objection, since the gated steps are already each car's and known at the draw, and it is withdrawn. Decision 73's row records both readings as options, with this reason
steps.no_gated_step: a scored climb must have at least one gated step (gated_step) on every car: one with none on a car has not been checked by C5 there and does not pass it (outcome case (2)); its gated steps are known at the draw, from the road, the car and its frozen plant, so the roads step discards such a climb at the draw and at a redraw, as a climb that fails a test of the first draw (redraw.redraw), and reports it
steps.transfer_row: the locked climb, decision 34's declared transfer row, is not one of decision 34's roads: it is never drawn or redrawn, and C5 gates nothing on it; its margins, computed as on a scored climb, are reported as decision 44 asks, beside the gear or ratio, the rpm and the margins to the kickdown and rpm bars (version 4's reading of decisions 34 and 44, written after its fifth review); the locked-climb cases of threshold (amendments F2 and F3) illustrate the rule and are not scored climbs

threshold.stepped: Vehicle.gear_for (engine_env.py:598-633) starts at the highest gear the road speed allows and hands one back while the demand f*r/(ratio*eta) exceeds Vehicle.shift_ceiling_nm(rpm) = min(SHIFT_LOAD*PEAK_TORQUE_NM, the deliverable-torque table at rpm) (:545-548), rpm the engine speed gear_for computes for that gear: the held gear's demand must sit more than the margin BELOW its ceiling, unless its next lower gear is barred (rpm_bar), and each rejected higher gear's more than the margin ABOVE its own
threshold.rpm_bar: a downshift barred by SHIFT_RPM_MAX cannot be caused by a torque error. The bar applies whenever the next lower gear's engine speed, as gear_for computes it, exceeds SHIFT_RPM_MAX (engine_env.py:630-631), whether or not the held gear's demand exceeds its ceiling: gear_for keeps the held gear either way, by its ceiling test or by the bar, so no torque error can hand it back. The held gear's own margin then does not gate; it is reported beside the bar's rpm margin, the lower gear's engine speed minus SHIFT_RPM_MAX, in rpm and as a fraction of SHIFT_RPM_MAX (positive while the bar holds). The rejected higher gears are still checked, as for a held lowest gear (no_decision). A script must not follow gear_for's control flow here: there, a held gear whose demand sits under its ceiling never reaches the bar's test, and would be gated as an ordinary hold; docs/build_step_2/AMENDMENTS.md F3's CX-9, whose 3rd gear is barred on its locked climb as F3 computes it, is such a case
threshold.cvt: decision 40's stateless kickdown (CvtVehicle.ratio_for, engine_env.py:813-852): its one discrete decision is at N_eco, so the threshold is kickdown_load*T_del(N_eco), CvtVehicle.kickdown_threshold_nm (engine_env.py:803-807), against T_eco: on the economy branch T_eco must sit more than the margin below it, on the kickdown and power-limited branches more than the margin above it
threshold.cvt_diagnostic: decision 40's diagnostic, reported and not gated: on the kickdown branch N* is the lowest engine speed of the window whose demand is at most target_load*T_del(N), and on the power-limited branch, where none is, the speed of most deliverable power (engine_env.py:836-852); if that feasible set, {N in the window: P_e/(omega*N) <= target_load*T_del(N)}, is not one interval, a torque error inside the margin can move N* into another interval, a discrete change of engine speed the margin at N_eco does not see, and so can a switch between the two branches; at every gated step on either branch the roads step, which applies C5, reports whether, with the demand and T_del each scaled by (1 +- the margin), the feasible set stays one interval and N* stays on its branch: at the draw, at R_E1a, and again at the re-check after the held-out run, at the re-check margin (redraw), on every redrawn climb too (version 4's fourth review placed it there; docs/build_step_2/AMENDMENTS.md section 3, decision 40: 'Report as a diagnostic whether N* stays in one connected feasible interval under demand and T_del x (1 +- m)'); C5 gates the law's one discrete decision, at N_eco, and that N* moves continuously everywhere else is an assumption this diagnostic reports
threshold.no_decision: at a step at which the box takes no torque decision the held gear's own margin is not gated, as at a barred downshift, and the step is reported with the CVT's branch or the held gear and the road speed: the CVT's low-speed branch, where ratio_for returns no N_eco (engine_env.py:820-821), which has no other margin, so the step passes; and a stepped box's held gear when it is the lowest, since gear_for compares the demand with a ceiling only while g > 0 (engine_env.py:624), whose rejected higher gears' margins are still gated. A demand at or below 0 (f <= 0: the CVT's economy hold of engine_env.py:833, or a stepped box on a descent) has |demand / threshold - 1| >= 1 against a positive threshold, and passes unless the margin reaches 1, wherever a margin is taken: rpm_bar and the cases above say first whether one is (version 4, written after its sixth review). At f <= 0 the CVT's low-speed branch, which ratio_for returns before its test of f (engine_env.py:820-821), still has no margin; a stepped box holds the highest gear the road speed allows, since the demand is under every ceiling, so it rejects no higher gear, and the held gear's own margin gates only when that gear is not its lowest and its next lower gear is not barred. Which of these steps are gated: steps.gated_step

redraw.slot: a climb slot is shared by the four cars (version 4, decision 75): decision 34 draws one set of test roads, whose preview ceiling is at least 2 MEI on every engine, so each slot of it is one climb for every car, the Supra's included
redraw.draw: decision 64: the roads are drawn with the margin at R_E1a on every car, before any held-out statistic; the roads' own seed, which fixes the redraw streams (stream), is committed with them by the roads step, and the cap and the discard bound are this contract's numbers (cap, discards; decision 76)
redraw.stream: each climb slot has its own stream, the sequence of candidate climbs the roads step's first-draw code draws, one after another, from the generator numpy.random.default_rng([roads_seed, stream_tag, k]): roads_seed is the non-negative integer the roads step draws the roads from and commits with them, before any held-out statistic; stream_tag is a label that separates these streams from any other drawn from that seed, as engine_env.TerrainTrainingEnv separates its road stream (_TERRAIN_STREAM), and the roads step draws no other stream under it; and k is the slot's index, from 0, in the order the slots are redrawn in (redraw). A slot's candidates therefore do not depend on how many another slot used, and the streams are fixed by the roads' own seed and nothing else (decision 76; the derivation fixed after version 4's sixth review, which found it left to the roads step, after the first fit, with the in-sample E1a known). The freedom that remains is the roads' own seed, which also picks the first draw: the roads step sets it after the freeze, as version 3 and decision 34 let it
redraw.recheck: after the held-out run every scored climb is re-checked on every car, each EPA engine's at its own max(R_E1a, |E1a| + 2u_val), |E1a| and u_val those of E1a's worst deciding line (conventions.statistic_details.lines), and the B58's at R_E1a; each deciding line's |E_l| + 2u_val,l is reported beside the margin, since a line with a smaller |E_l| and a larger u_val can leave more than the worst line's |E1a| + 2u_val, which the margin, as decision 64 reads ('of the worst line', docs/build_step_2/PLAN.md decision 64), does not see
redraw.redraw: a scored climb that fails C5 (steps.outcome case (1)) on any car is redrawn from its slot's stream for every car (decision 75). A redraw is the next climb of the slot's stream that passes every test the roads step applies to a climb of its first draw, with the same code: decision 34's preview ceiling of at least 2 MEI on every engine, C5 at R_E1a with at least one gated step on every car, a test a candidate passes when, on every car, it is in steps.outcome case (2) or (3) and has a gated step (one in case (2) on a car is accepted and flagged thin there, as at the first draw), and the roads step's own checks. Each test is applied as the first draw applies it: a test of a climb to the candidate, and a test of a road or of the road set to that road or set with the candidate in the slot and every other slot as it then stands; decision 34's ceiling is of the second kind, a property of the roads ('chosen so that the preview ceiling ... is at least twice the MEI on every engine'), not of one climb. A candidate that fails one is discarded, as at the first draw, is not a redraw and is not counted against the cap, and the number discarded is reported. The slots are redrawn in their order on the roads, the roads in the order the roads step records them and a road's slots by their first step, each slot's redraws ending before the next slot's begin, and every car's C5 is then checked again on the new climb at its re-check margin (version 4, decisions 75 and 76; the tests' level and the order written after its fifth review, the order's definition after its sixth)
redraw.extent: a candidate fills its slot's recorded extent (version 4, decision 75, written after its sixth review): the first draw's code draws it as a climb of the slot's length, from the slot's recorded first step to its last (steps.range), joined to the road at both ends as a climb of the first draw is; the road outside the slot, the slot's first and last steps and every other slot's record stay as recorded, so a redraw moves the transition and gated-step counts of that slot alone, and the road set decision 34's ceiling is computed on only inside it; a candidate that code cannot give at the slot's length is discarded, as one that fails a test of the first draw
redraw.cap: at most 3 redraws per climb slot, counted over all cars: one for each redraw, whichever car's failure caused it (decisions 75 and 76); a number of this contract, fixed before any fit and from no data (DESIGN), which the roads step commits with the roads as written here: three redraws bound how far one engine's held-out E1a can move a slot, and leave a slot whose candidates each fail with probability p without a passing climb with probability p**3, one in eight at p = 1/2
redraw.discards: at most 100 candidates discarded per slot, counted over its redraws: when the last of them is discarded the slot stops redrawing and keeps its last climb for every car, as a slot at the cap does (at_cap), and the stop is reported (decision 76). A slot's stream has no end and discarded candidates are not counted against the cap, so without this bound a slot whose candidates kept failing the first draw's tests would never be settled; the bound only ends such a stream
redraw.at_cap: a slot whose redraws reach the cap, or stop at the discard bound, keeps the last climb accepted for it, its original or its last redraw and never a discarded candidate (named after version 4's sixth review), for every car; on each car on which that climb fails C5 (steps.outcome case (1)) the slot is scored, flagged gear-sensitive with its margins listed, and flagged thin too where the climb is thin on that car (steps.thin), and that car's results are reported with and without its flagged slots (decision 74, read with 75): dropping the slot would shorten that car's scored set on the strength of a held-out statistic (E1a), which decision 64 avoids for a whole car
redraw.no_passing_car: a car with no passing climb is not dropped: C5 is a rule, not a gate; its scored climbs' margins are listed, each slot keeping its last accepted climb as every slot at the cap does (decisions 74 and 75), and it is reported by what its climbs are on it: gear-sensitive (decision 64) when a slot is flagged gear-sensitive on it, thinly checked when a climb is flagged thin on it (steps.thin), and both when it has both, as it has when a slot at the cap keeps a thin climb that fails there. A thin climb with no failing gated step (steps.outcome case (2)) neither passes nor fails C5: it is not a passing climb, and it does not make its car gear-sensitive; a thin climb that fails at a gated step (case (1)) fails C5 there, as any climb does (version 4's reading of decisions 64 and 73, written after its sixth review; the cases after its seventh)
redraw.disclosed: a redraw moves every car's scored set on the strength of one engine's held-out E1a, the price of decision 34's one road set (decision 75): the redraws are reported per slot, with the car and the margin that caused each; and L1's and E8's tightenings were measured on the roads as first drawn, which is disclosed
redraw.rule_0: the streams are fixed by the roads' own seed, which the roads step sets and commits with the roads after the freeze and before any held-out statistic, as decision 64 places it, through the derivation written here (stream); that derivation, the cap and the discard bound are fixed here, before any fit (decision 76); none of them changes after the held-out run. Rule 0 freezes this rule and these numbers, as it lets the roads and the L1 and E8 tightenings, which also come after the first fit, be set by the step this contract names. The one change after the held-out run is the redraw itself: a climb that fails at its re-check margin is replaced from its slot's committed stream, within the cap and the discard bound, which moves the scored climbs and nothing else; the tightenings stay as measured on the roads as first drawn (disclosed)
